pageDescription: FMS uses Font Awesome 6 Pro for UI icons (Solid, Regular, and Light). The design system handbook documents principles and usage at Foundations → Icons → Overview (/foundation/icons/overview).

rows: Font Awesome 6 Pro via the shared Font Awesome Kit npm package
Emojis, random SVGs, or other icon libraries unless design specifies otherwise
Match Figma: style (solid / regular / light) and icon name
Guess icon names or swap styles without checking design
Monochrome icons using text/icon colour tokens

basicMarkup.title: Basic markup
basicMarkup.intro: Font Awesome 6 uses two class names: style prefix + icon name (kebab-case).

iconSearchNote.afterLink: and copy the class name from the kit (e.g. magnifying-glass, not legacy search unless Figma uses it).

size.label: Size
size.body: For larger contexts (showcase, marketing), size explicitly only when Figma specifies it — don’t invent sizes.

colour.label: Colour
body: Icons should read like typography for contrast, but slightly lighter.
Inherit colour from the parent when the icon sits in a button or menu row so hover/active states stay consistent.
